# Nyanpash's Website

> Welcome to my website! I may post about games, animanga, shitposts, and waifus too, so nice to meet you!

- Site owner: Nyanpash
- Kana: ニャンパッシュ

## About Nyanpash

A fondness for cats that borders on infatuation. The name comes from nyan, the sound of a cat's meow, and pash, an infatuation or strong admiration. Somewhere along the way, it became a corner of the internet that grew into an online presence, spanning different interests, passions, and everything in between.

Also, there might just be another reason the name feels familiar. Perhaps you love Non Non Biyori as well?
